description: This PHP source file defines the UserPreferencesService class, which provides functionality to retrieve user preferences from the database in a SuiteCRM environment. It interacts with other components such as BeanManager and database utilities to fetch and serialize user preference data.

classes.name: UserPreferencesService
classes.description: A service class that handles retrieval of user preferences for a specific user, encapsulating database access and response formatting.
